# orion query

Find cards and groups with an expression

```sh
orion query [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                        |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `--where <value>` | **Required.** Expression selecting cards or groups |
| `--all`           | Include done items                                 |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                         |
